title: Chameleon reading a book
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- branch -->
  <rect x="10" y="78" width="80" height="6" rx="3" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <rect x="10" y="78" width="80" height="2" rx="1" fill="#A9713A"/>
  <!-- tail curling around branch -->
  <path d="M22 74 C10 74 8 88 20 88 C30 88 30 78 22 78" fill="none" stroke="#3CB371" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="24" ry="16" fill="#3CB371"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="20" ry="11" fill="#4FD98A"/>
  <!-- back spikes -->
  <path d="M34 50 L37 42 L40 50 L44 41 L47 50 L51 42 L54 50 L58 43 L61 51" fill="none" stroke="#2E8B57" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- front legs holding book -->
  <path d="M38 66 C34 70 33 74 36 76" fill="none" stroke="#2E8B57" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M62 66 C66 70 67 74 64 76" fill="none" stroke="#2E8B57" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- book -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="36,70 50,68 50,82 36,84" fill="#E8453C"/>
    <polygon points="64,70 50,68 50,82 64,84" fill="#F26B5E"/>
    <polygon points="36,70 50,68 50,81 36,83" fill="#FFD15C" opacity="0.15"/>
    <line x1="50" y1="68" x2="50" y2="82" stroke="#B5322B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="72" x2="47" y2="71.3" stroke="#FFE9A8" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="75.5" x2="47" y2="74.8" stroke="#FFE9A8" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="79" x2="47" y2="78.3" stroke="#FFE9A8" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="53" y1="71.3" x2="60" y2="72" stroke="#FFE9A8" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="53" y1="74.8" x2="60" y2="75.5" stroke="#FFE9A8" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="44" rx="13" ry="11" fill="#3CB371"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="42" rx="10" ry="8" fill="#4FD98A"/>
  <!-- casque/crest -->
  <path d="M60 34 Q68 24 76 34 Q72 32 66 34" fill="#2E8B57"/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx="70" cy="41" r="5" fill="#FFE9A8"/>
  <circle cx="71" cy="41" r="2.5" fill="#1C3B2A"/>
  <circle cx="71.8" cy="40" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- mouth smile -->
  <path d="M76 48 Q72 51 68 49" fill="none" stroke="#1C3B2A" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- tongue tip toward book -->
  <path d="M64 50 Q58 54 54 62" fill="none" stroke="#FF6FA0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="62" r="2" fill="#FF6FA0"/>
  <!-- curled leaf detail on branch -->
  <path d="M84 78 Q88 72 86 66 Q84 70 82 74" fill="#2E8B57"/>
</svg>
